rationale: Section s45 (n4→n5) is faulted. All three FCIs (at n1, n2, n4) detect fault current because the fault is downstream of all of them on the radial path. Only customer node n5 is downstream of the fault and thus outaged, which exactly matches the single outage complaint. This is the only section that minimizes mismatch against both observed FCI states and complaint nodes.
